claims.statement: Réka Albert, Hawoong Jeong, and Albert-László Barabási published Error and Attack Tolerance of Complex Networks in Nature 406:378-382 on July 27 2000

claims.statement: Original paper distinguishes random node failure/error from selective removal of high-connectivity nodes in graph simulations
Paper reports scale-free and real network case studies comparatively tolerant to random failures yet sensitive to targeted removal of important vertices
Nature published official correction Jan 25 2001 volume409 page542 DOI 10.1038/35054111

Correction states software error affected random error tolerance curves for exponential comparison network and corrected Figs2a 3a, but not attack curves nor core results for scale-free, Web and Internet networks
Cohen Erez ben-Avraham Havlin published Resilience of Internet to Random Breakdowns in PRL 85:4626-4628 on Nov 20 2000

claims.statement: Seven-vertex star, one hub 6 leaves: hub loss leaves six isolated vertices, leaf loss leaves connected six-node star; uniform one node failure hits hub probability 1/7
